reporting_basis: CONSOLIDATED (Group). CONFIRMED EXPLICITLY 2026-08-26 (previously inferred from magnitude only -- see prior note preserved below). Evidence now includes three independently cross-checked, explicitly labelled sources in the FY2024 and FY2025 annual reports: (1) Note 14.a.2.1 'Capital to Risk-weighted assets Ratios (CRAR) as defined by the Basel Capital Accord (Consolidated)' gives Total Regulatory Capital BDT 37,013.20m (FY2024) / BDT 42,203.69m (FY2025), which reproduce exactly in each year's 'Five-Year/Five Year at a Glance' table; the parallel Note 14.a.2.2 '...(Solo)' gives different, lower figures (BDT 36,390.61m / BDT 41,725.12m) matching Annexure F(i) 'Financial Highlights on the Overall Activities (Solo)' instead. (2) The Segment Report's explicit 'Consolidated' column (Annexure G-i, Segment Report Consolidated Balance Sheet) gives Total Assets BDT 457,203.99m (FY2024) / BDT 505,191.83m (FY2025), matching the Five-Year at a Glance table exactly, while its explicit 'Solo' column (BDT 454,310.97m / BDT 501,549.92m) matches Annexure F(i) instead. (3) Re-checking the already-used FY2023 report with this same method confirms the same pattern retroactively: FY2023's 'Five Years at a Glance' Total Assets (369,327) matches Annexure-F 'Consolidated Financial Highlights' (369,327.17) exactly, not Annexure F(i) 'Financial Highlights' (Solo, 366,807.68) -- validating that all of 2011-2023's already-stored data (sourced from the same style of table) is Consolidated as previously assumed. One caveat found while confirming this: the Credit Metrics section (classified loans, NPL%, NPL coverage) within the otherwise-Consolidated 'Five-Year at a Glance' table is explicitly labelled '(SOLO)' starting with the FY2024 report's table -- numerically basis-invariant in practice (subsidiaries MTBSL/MTBCL/MTB Islamic Banking window carry no loan book of their own), confirmed by identical classified-loan and provision figures in FY2023's Solo and Consolidated annexures, but noted for anyone relying on npl_pct alongside this record's Consolidated gross_loans field (dividing by Solo gross loans instead of the stored Consolidated figure changes the reproduced NPL% by ~0.04-0.05pp -- see 2024_Q4.json/2025_Q4.json period_note for the exact figures). MTB's consolidated basis can now be treated as confirmed, not merely inferred, in any published comparison.
notes: annual_reports/MTB archive was already text-extracted (2011-2025, 15 files) by a parallel session working on this project before this session began processing it; this session only performed the financial-data extraction and structuring. Complete Q4/year-end coverage for 2011-2023 achieved from just three overlapping annual reports' unusually detailed 'Financials at a Glance' / 'Five Years at a Glance' tables (balance sheet, income statement, capital, credit-quality, and shares-information sections all in one place). FY2024 and FY2025 extended in a second session (2026-08-26) from the same style of table plus, newly, an explicit Solo-vs-Consolidated cross-check (Note 14.a.2.1/14.a.2.2 and the Segment Report's Annexure G-i/G-ii) that confirms the reporting basis explicitly rather than by magnitude inference -- see reporting_basis above. QUARTERLY (Q1-Q3) BACKFILL (2026-08-26, third session): FY2019-2025 (7 years, full Q1/Q2/Q3) mined from each year's own annual report's embedded 'Evaluation of the (Consolidated) Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and by the Board' table -- a BSEC-mandated disclosure confirmed absent in FY2011-2018 reports. Additionally, 6 more quarters spanning 2013/2014/2015/2016/2017/2018 (one quarter per year, for breadth) were recovered from MTB's own website (mutualtrustbank.com/regulatory-disclosure/financial-statements/), 3 via clean pdftotext and 3 via OCR (balance-sheet only, P&L excluded where OCR proved unreliable -- see the discrepancy/OCR source entries below for the full derivation and a proven OCR digit-misread example). Q1-Q3 is now populated for every year 2013-2025 except several individual quarters of 2013-2018 not yet fetched (time-boxed); 2011-2012 have no interim filings at all (confirmed via the site's own listing, not assumed) and remain Q4-only permanently. QUARTERLY BACKFILL COMPLETION (2026-08-27, fourth session): the remaining 11 scoped gaps -- 2013 Q2/Q3, 2014 Q1/Q2, 2015 Q2/Q3, 2016 Q3, 2017 Q2/Q3, 2018 Q1/Q2 -- were all fetched from mutualtrustbank.com/regulatory-disclosure/financial-statements/, plus one bonus quarter (2016 Q1, listed on the site as a .jpg rather than a PDF) beyond the original scope. All 12 were SCANNED IMAGE PDFs/JPEGs (pdftotext extracted 0 lines from every one); tesseract OCR (pdftoppm 300dpi + tesseract --psm 6) was attempted first but badly interleaves this template's 3-column layout (Balance Sheet | P&L | Notes), merging unrelated rows onto the same OCR line, so all 12 were instead recovered by directly reading the rasterized page image (the extracting model reading the PNG/JPEG visually) and cross-validating every figure against the balance-sheet identity, the full P&L chain (Operating Income - Expenses = Profit Before Provision - Provision = Profit Before Tax - Tax = Net Profit After Tax), and the Dec-31 comparative column vs. the already-stored neighboring Q4.json -- all 12 passed with at most BDT 1 (rounding) drift on the identity/chain checks, and 11 of 12 Dec-31 comparative fields matched stored Q4 data exactly (one immaterial ~0.09% divergence in 2016's Investments figure, and a separately pre-existing ~0.01-0.02% divergence in 2015's total-assets figure across multiple vintages, both noted in the affected quarter files, neither newly introduced this session). A recurring template trap was found and corrected: MTB's interim P&L layout prints an unlabelled boxed subtotal (Investment Income + Commission + Other Operating Income) directly above the true bold 'Total Operating Income' row (which additionally adds back Net Interest Income) -- an initial read of 2013_Q3 mis-picked the subtotal before this was caught via the P&L chain not reconciling; all subsequent files checked this explicitly, and one further tax-line misread on 2017_Q3 was caught the same way. Full balance-sheet + P&L Q1-Q3 coverage for MTB is now complete for every year 2013-2025 with a genuine interim filing (2011-2012 confirmed to have none). Raw PDFs/JPEG deleted after extraction per project policy; visual transcriptions kept as annual_reports/MTB/mtb-unaudited-*-visual.txt. 2026 Q1/Q2 EXTENSION (2026-08-27, same session): also fetched MTB's now-published 2026 Q1 and H1 interim filings (both CLEAN TEXT PDFs, no OCR needed) directly from the site's regulatory-disclosure page, extending the Q1-Q3 series to the present. These introduced a new balance-sheet breakout not seen in earlier years -- a 'Bond' total that itself splits into 'Perpetual Bond' (BDT 4,000m, stable) and 'Subordinated Debts' (amortizing down from Sep-2025's implied ~9,550m); the combined Bond figure is stored in 'subordinated_debt' for balance-sheet-identity continuity with earlier years' single-line convention, with 'perpetual_bond' added as a new supplementary line item. Both quarters validated exactly (balance-sheet identity and full P&L chain, including correctly signed net TAX CREDITS in both periods).
